what: Provenance for every data file the interactive notebook reads.
rule: Every number in the notebook traces to a file in this repository. The manuscript is authoritative where a source disagrees with it.

files.d1_games.json: one bundled game scored ply by ply
files.d2_anomaly.json: anomaly detection results and the toy bell-curve parameters
files.d5_architecture.json: network stages and real tensor shapes
files.d6_bootstrap.json: paired bootstrap draws and arm results
files.d7_subgroups.json: MAE by time control and rating bracket
files.d11_arms.json: every deck game read under each rating arm
files.d12_separation.json: White/Black separation by real rating gap
